cohort: 151,333 Chinese women who gave birth between April 2013 and May 2016
finding: Forceps-assisted delivery and cesarean section were associated with an increased risk of severe postpartum hemorrhage, with a more pronounced effect observed in multiparous women compared to nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Forceps-assisted delivery and caesarean section were associated with a higher risk of severe PPH compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery, with a greater risk difference observed in multiparous women.
